status_summary: A final rule published and effective 2025-12-29 ended the Office of the Executive Secretariat as a separate DOJ component and returned its document-clearance functions to a staff within the Justice Management Division, citing deregulatory and streamlining initiatives. This consolidates one management support function but does not touch the public and legislative affairs merger the text describes, and the rule does not mention either office. The department's organization chart page, last modified 2026-06-30, still lists the Office of Public Affairs and the Office of Legislative Affairs as separate offices.

timeline.event: DOJ final rule removes the Office of the Executive Secretariat as a separate component and places its functions in the Justice Management Division (28 CFR part 0 amendments).

title: Merge DOJ public and legislative affairs offices and consolidate support functions
uncertainties: Verified by fetching the Federal Register rule and the justice.gov organization chart page.
